---
name: Translation issue
about: A problem with the Portuguese or Spanish documentation
title: "i18n: "
labels: ["i18n"]
---

**Language**
pt-BR or es.

**Page**
Link to the page or give its path under `docs/book/`.

**Problem**
Wrong term, missing update compared with English, broken link, or awkward
phrasing.

**Suggested fix**
When the term is part of the shared vocabulary, check
`docs/book/GLOSSARY.md` first.
